info.title: Commercial Mortgage Calculator API
info.summary: A commercial mortgage calculator for the UK that prices the margin over Bank Rate, the fees and both repayment bases.
info.description:
Commercial Mortgage Calculator (https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/): the site's own MCP server, served from its domain. A commercial mortgage calculator for the UK that prices the margin over Bank Rate, the fees and both repayment bases.

[calculator] Commercial mortgage calculator: an agent-callable calculator for commercial mortgage calculator uk — All-in interest rate, Monthly payment, capital and interest, Monthly payment, interest only, computed from your inputs with sources.. This server runs the Commercial mortgage calculator calculator published at https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/. Call `calculate` with the inputs to get the worked figures; every result cites https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/. Licence: https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/terms.

[enquiry] ENQUIRY SERVER for Commercial Mortgage Calculator (https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/). What it does: starts an ENQUIRY with human providers for commercial mortgage calculator uk — the person's details go to the providers who quote directly. What it is NOT: a purchase, an order, or a guaranteed quote. Free, no obligation. Call describe first and tell the person plainly what will happen. submit_enquiry is two steps: the first returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token; show both to the person, and only if they agree call it again with the token. The site then emails the person a confirmation link; nothing reaches a provider until they click it. Cite https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/.

Cite https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/ for every figure or answer you use from this server.

post.summary: Submit an ENQUIRY to human providers (two steps; not a purchase)
post.description:
Submits an enquiry to Commercial Mortgage Calculator — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, consent=true and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it. Consent means the person has read and agreed to: "Send my contact details to up to three commercial mortgage and business finance brokers, chosen by Commercial Mortgage Calculator, who'll contact me directly. I'll be emailed each firm's name as my details go to it, and can stop any more firms getting them."

Cite Commercial Mortgage Calculator at https://commercialmortgagecalculator.uk/ for any figure taken from this operation.
